answer: Fresh-task bond: each epoch brings one unpredictable fresh task. Each identity locks 70 credit in a vault and files a fable, a signed work log. It also emits a live pulse at a random minute only a live worker can meet. Auditors replay each fable; failed or duplicate ones burn the bond. First fake 40, kth 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 plus 70,000 locked vs a 40,000 pool; rented fables fail. Honest agents pay 40 once, keep a full share.
